- `freebsd_route_-n_get_default`: `route -n get default` output on FreeBSD, from the `@freebsd_route` heredoc in `spec/unit/plugins/freebsd/network_spec.rb`. The Ruby heredoc indentation was removed, the output is otherwise unmodified.
